notes: Batch of 15 IRS groups: 7 publish, 8 hide. Two searches used, both for groups whose website field was not a web address. Parkside Angling Association: no page found. PDR Swimming for Success: found the team's own site, read, and status set to dormant from 2023 evidence (low confidence). Dead domains are listed under blocked but are not bot blocks. Judgment calls for owner review: (1) Mid-Atlantic Eurasia Business Council is kept although mainly a trade council; (2) Penn State Alumni Association Philadelphia Chapter is hidden under the alumni rule even though it lists public volunteer events; (3) Pennsylvania Education for All Coalition is listed while its nonpartisan status is not stated on the site; (4) Parkside Angling Association has no audience, schedule or summary facts beyond its IRS address, so it should stay unpublished until a source is found. Year-only evidence (2026 on Philly Black Pride and the Philadelphia Botanical Club site) is treated as active with no month recorded. No rate limiting was seen. Budget: 2 of 2 searches used, 21 fetch calls.
